headline: ADB ups India's FY27 GDP projections to 6.9%; flags prolonged Middle East conflict risk for Asia - OrissaPOST
summary: The Asian Development Bank projects India's GDP growth at 6.9% this fiscal year and 7.3% next fiscal year. It flags prolonged Middle East conflict risk for Asia.
why: The Asian Development Bank is a regional lender that publishes growth forecasts for Asian economies. Its outlook informs investment and policy decisions across the region.
